key_impacts: Fishermen lost most of their fishing boats
Parts of mangroves remained under water
Properties in low-lying coastal areas were destroyed
Few lives lost after coast guards warned people to move away from beaches and low areas
evidence_snippets: “was Amu affected and how?” … “Within two hours, mountains of waves started to hit the coast.”
“The fishermen lost most of their fishing boats… A lot of properties in the low-lying areas were also destroyed.”

key_impacts: People lost most of their animals due to lack of drinking water
No electricity for industries and homes
Industries were forced to close and many people lost jobs
Community survived mainly on food relief
evidence_snippets: “It sometimes continues for several years, like in 1999-2001.”
“People lost most of their animals as a result of no drinking water.”
“During that particular drought, we mainly survived on food relief…”
